subject: Copywriting
title: John Caples: Testing Headlines
description: Learn John Caples: Testing Headlines in one minute.

hook.text: 'They Laughed When I Sat Down at the Piano—But When I Started to Play!' John Caples wrote the most famous headline ever.

buildup.text: Caples worked at BBDO and became the master of direct response ads that measured every dollar spent against dollars.

discovery.text: His book 'Tested Advertising Methods' catalogued which headline formulas worked and which flopped, proven by data.

twist.text: Caples proved changing just the headline could multiply response rates by 19x. Everything else—same copy, same product.

climax.text: The annual Caples Awards honor him. Every A/B test in digital marketing is Caples' legacy, digitized.

punchline.text: One headline, 19x more sales. Caples proved words pay.

quiz.question: By how much could a headline change multiply response rates according to Caples?
